8a7e4a173ee965bef6d615ed6f122bd037d0c028.rationale: The patient's presentation of a painless, round, hazelnut-sized mass localized to the tail of the right epididymis with ultrasonography demonstrating a solid, well-demarcated, hyperechoic, hypoperfused mass is most consistent with an Adenomatoid tumor, which has the highest score and most supporting evidence.
